subject.title: Guard Skill Workshop update applies against delta drafts

question: Should Skill Workshop update apply fail closed on the branch's tested proposal-note heuristics, accepting that an uncommon valid replacement might need revision before it can be applied?
rationale: The patch fixes a demonstrated destructive overwrite path, but tests cannot eliminate every false-positive content shape and current releases accept all replacement bodies.

options.title: Accept the guarded apply boundary
options.body: Land the current validator because preventing destructive proposal-stub overwrites outweighs the bounded risk that a valid draft must be revised.

options.title: Narrow the marker policy
options.body: Require additional allow cases or fewer strong markers before merge to reduce rejection risk at the cost of permitting more malformed update drafts.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded apply boundary
recommendation.body: Land the current validator because preventing destructive proposal-stub overwrites outweighs the bounded risk that a valid draft must be revised.
